capabilities: Export the active Markdown note to a .docx file next to the source note
Map Markdown headings to Word heading levels and preserve clickable links
Adjust overly light text colors so they stay readable on white paper
Rasterize SVG and WebP images to PNG and convert captions to numbered paragraphs
Export notes and assembled Longform projects via Pandoc with citation conversion
extras: The Pandoc export path requires a local Pandoc installation and supports optional bibliography, CSL, and reference DOCX settings; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce a .docx file that keeps heading structure, clickable links, and readable text colors when opened in Word, Pages, or Google Docs.

relations.evidence: Adds Pandoc export commands for both the active note and assembled Longform projects.
The Longform command works from either a Longform index note or one of its scene notes
strips PDF Scholia Scribe's managed reference block, preserves ordinary @citekey citations

summary: Exports Markdown notes to DOCX with Word-compatible headings, links and readable colors, plus Pandoc export for citations and Longform projects.
